records.name: MUNBYN RW941BP 300 DPI Bluetooth Thermal Shipping Label Printer (4 x 6, Bluetooth + USB, iPhone/Android/Windows/Mac)
specs: Direct thermal, 300 dpi; MUNBYN says the print head is made by ROHM (Japan)
Up to 150 mm/s in MUNBYN's FAQ; the product description says up to 180 mm/s
40-110 mm in MUNBYN's FAQ (40-104 mm / 1.57-4.3 in in the description); takes 4 x 6 shipping labels; automatic size detection
Bluetooth to iPhone, iPad, Android and Windows (MUNBYN Print app on phones); USB to Windows and Mac; no Wi-Fi listed
UPS, USPS, FedEx, Etsy, eBay, Shopify, Amazon, Shippo, Easyship, ShipStation, PayPal and others (MUNBYN FAQ)
About 980,000 4 x 6 labels (MUNBYN lab estimate from a 150 km print-head rating)
Pink $125.99; White or Green $132.99; printer + label bundles from $177.99
records.warranty: MUNBYN gives label printers a 24-month warranty counted from the day the order is paid, with technical support; extended warranty years are sold separately (for example $34 for one extra year on the RW941BP). Labels, label holders and refurbished items are not covered.
records.returns: MUNBYN's refund policy allows a return for exchange or refund within 14 days of receiving the item; the buyer arranges and pays return shipping, no restocking fee is charged, and for faulty items MUNBYN refunds the return postage. Personalized items cannot be returned.
records.summary: A 300 dpi thermal label printer for 4 x 6 shipping labels and smaller product, barcode and QR labels, printing from phones over Bluetooth or from Windows and Mac computers over USB, with no ink. MUNBYN calls it its best-selling printer and sells it from $125.99.
records.fit: Suits online sellers who print shipping labels plus small-text product labels, logos or dense barcodes, where 300 dpi is sharper than the usual 203 dpi. Sellers who only print standard shipping labels can save about $50 with MUNBYN's 203 dpi RW403B ($74.99 at munbyn.com).
caveats: MUNBYN gives two print speeds (150 mm/s in the FAQ, 180 mm/s in the description) and two label-width ranges (40-110 mm vs 40-104 mm) for this printer.
No independent review of the RW941BP was found; the 980,000-label print-head life is MUNBYN's own lab estimate.
Weight, dimensions and box contents are not stated by MUNBYN on the product page.
Only the Pink color is $125.99; White and Green cost $132.99 (8% codes bring those to $122.36).
MUNBYN's product pages advertise a '14-day risk-free trial' and a '30-day price-match', while its written refund policy gives 14 days from receipt with the buyer paying return shipping.

records.summary: A 203 dpi Bluetooth thermal printer for 4 x 6 shipping labels and smaller product and round labels, with automatic label calibration and wireless printing from phones, Windows and Mac. TechRadar's Jim Hill rated it 4.5/5 and had no misprints or jams in testing; MUNBYN sells it from $74.99.
records.fit: Suits first-time online sellers who want a cheap, wireless 4 x 6 shipping-label printer that also prints product and circle labels. Sellers whose labels carry small text or fine logos should consider MUNBYN's 300 dpi RW941BP ($125.99), and anyone who only needs small 2-inch labels can spend less on a NIIMBOT B1 ($23.99 at niimbot.com/us).
caveats: TechRadar (Jim Hill, September 2025, 4.5/5) lists no Wi-Fi, no included roll holder, 'expensive media' and print that 'could be sharper' (203 dpi) as drawbacks.
TechRadar caused a paper jam by feeding a label roll carelessly; without a built-in roll holder the roll needs room to unwind (holders and kits are sold separately).
Only the White color is $74.99; Panda and Pink cost $79.99 (8% codes bring those to $73.59).
